items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I got to meet some of the old timers... Like, Bunk Johnson... I never had an idea that I would meet them.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now, like, when we got to Louisiana, I got to meet some of the old timers, that other people hadn't met, that were legendary, you know? And I never had an idea that I would meet them. Like, Bunk Johnson, he was supposed to have been Louis Armstrong's idol and teacher. Bunk showed him a few things on the trumpet. Kid Ory I met out there, and I met him here in Los Angeles. So we had a sort of a relationship going. I met Ed Garland out here. But he happened to be in Louisiana at the time, because it was near…
Did you hear them all play?
